facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price), payable once the caravans flow again and he can truck the goods to town.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated whether the note was handed over or pledged, or how it is split between the two hirelings.

facts.text: Cedric's note pays nothing until the caravans flow again, which blocks paying Malzazarik and Lady Hilda from it.
